title: VL+ (Art)
description: Changes textures from the VL+ pack or VL pack to be more artistically influenced
body:
## The VL+ artpack is supposed to be layerd on top of the normal [VL+ Pack](https://modrinth.com/project/GdELn0Xz) or regular Ventureland Pack

Make sure to check the versions tab and click on a version to see its required mods for it to function. Alternatively use OptiFine.

Current changes are:
- Enhancers are fully colored in
- Captains sword has a unique texture
- Color changed queens and amal uniques

Download this pack for a difference compare to the normal VL+ pack or a small change for the normal original pack
